newsitem.title: USA: Argentine CLISA to debut in U.S. junk bond market.
newsitem.headline: Argentine CLISA to debut in U.S. junk bond market.

text.p: Compaa Latinoamericana de Infraestructura & Servicios SA (CLISA) is planning to debut in the U.S. high-yield bond market with a $100 million offering in the next few weeks, market sources said.
CLISA, a private Argentine infrastructure and construction company, plans to use the proceeds of the offering to refinance debt, they said.

Citicorp Securities Inc will be the sole manager of the offering of seven-year, non-callable guaranteed senior notes. The notes will be sold as a 144a private placement without registration rights, sources said.
The roadshow for the deal will be held in the U.S. from May 12 through about May 21, sources said.

CLISA will join a handful of Argentine companies to issue junk bonds in the U.S. Other Argentine issuers this year include Multicanal SA, an Argentine cable TV concern, with a $250 million offering, and steel company, Acindar Industria Argentina, with a $100 million offering.
